question: Where was the Shaurya Van, dedicated to the bravery of Indian soldiers, inaugurated by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaisalmer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurated Shaurya Van in Jaisalmer, dedicated to the bravery of Indian soldiers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Shaurya Van is located in the Thar Desert and is part of the 1971 Indo-Pak war museum in Jaisalmer.
 
• The light-and-sound show at Shaurya Van honours the sacrifices and valour of the Armed Forces.
 
• Rajnath Singh also released the Defence Procurement Manual (DPM) 2025 at a separate event in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The DPM 2025 aims to improve procurement procedures, promote self-reliance, and increase opportunities for MSMEs in defence manufacturing.
 
• The manual includes new provisions for indigenisation, procurement on a PAC basis, and reforms to expedite decision-making processes.
